rulings.restated: Input — The amount of this item to include in income for 2025
rulings.model: The line is NonNegDollars, but the IRS line 8z examples include a 'Loss on certain corrective distributions of excess deferrals'; a loss cannot be entered as a nonnegative amount to include in income.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; i1040gi p. 92: a loss on line 8z is outside the tool; the line takes positive amounts only. Project stands.
